summary: Build nonprofit results frameworks, indicator trackers and reporting plans. Explore practical M&E training and enrol with TrainingCred.
lede: Monitoring and evaluation frameworks connect programme activities to outputs and outcomes through a practical chain of evidence. Designed for nonprofit programme officers, monitoring staff and managers, the course covers mapping a theory of change and logical framework, defining indicators with baselines and targets, and checking data quality with an Excel tracker. You’ll also practise framing evaluation questions and interpreting findings for programme and donor reporting.
audienceIntro: This foundation-level course is designed for nonprofit professionals who plan, monitor, evaluate or report on programmes and need practical tools for connecting activities to outcomes.
modules: Theory of Change and Logical Frameworks
Indicator Reference Sheets and Data Quality
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with nonprofit programme activities is useful. No prior experience designing M&E frameworks or coding/programming is required. Advanced methods such as contribution analysis and outcome harvesting receive introductory, conceptual coverage.
